integrity: All claims are mathematical deductions from an explicit signed-difference identity and ordered-disk gap criterion. Finite checker examples do not establish universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Initial domains are finite unions of pairwise disjoint disks rather than connected or convex sets. Original covariograms, not dilated covariograms, coincide. Linear disparity is a growth-order statement, not an optimal constant. The homometric six-point pair and convolution are classical; priority of the offset-connectivity phenomenon is provisional.
title: Homometric disk unions with a linear gap in offset connectivity
